statement: For C:y^2=x^3-x,z^3=3x^4-6x^2-1, the complement of the nine points above E[3] is an actual degree27 Heisenberg cover of U, with genus10. At every coefficient prime its nontrivial procyclic subgroups with open arithmetic normalizer are precisely cusp inertia subgroups. Its pro3 full fixed subgroup is selected cusp inertia by A.22. The Jacobian is isogenous to E times E0^3 times B^3, where E0 has j=0 and the surface B has Q(sqrt(-3)) action but no geometric CM factor.
